summary: Immix Biopharma filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing positive interim Phase 2 NEXICART-2 data for NXC-201 in relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis, reporting an 89% (40/45) complete response rate by independent review, with all 25 new patients in CR or MRD-negative and no relapses. The filing contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor. This is a routine clinical-update current report, not a special situation; the registrant is the filer. Watch for final readout and BLA submission in mid-2027 as the next catalysts.
